Title: Retirement: AKS GPU image (preview) will retire on Jan 10, 2025

Body.Content:
You will no longer be able to create new GPU-enabled node pools with the GPU image. We recommend customers with GPU image enabled node pools to migrate existing workloads onto GPU-enabled node pools created with the AKS supported solutions of (1) Default Experience with NVIDIA device plugin installation, or (2) GPU Operator.

To learn more about this retirement, visit on AKS.
You can view the alternative options for NVIDIA GPUs on AKS.
